info.description: The Loyalty Balances API provides a means for businesses to access and manage customer loyalty balance information. This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed account balance data for enrolled loyalty program participants. It is particularly useful for customer service representatives and marketing teams who aim to enhance customer engagement through targeted programs. Developers can integrate this API to facilitate real-time balance inquiries, thereby improving the customer experience and optimizing loyalty rewards management.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the current loyalty balance for a specific user. It provides detailed information about the user's loyalty points and status.

requestBody.description: The request body for retrieving the loyalty balance. This body must conform to the defined schema, specifying the necessary information for the balance retrieval.
